Job Summary

• Ensure the effective development, negotiation, and administration of commercial and contractual activities supporting project execution.
• Lead end-to-end commercial strategy, including cost analysis, risk management, and client engagement to optimize financial and operational outcomes.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to prepare, review, and finalize contractual documents and ensure compliance with corporate and client requirements.
• Drive continuous improvement in commercial processes to enhance project profitability, contract governance, and business sustainability.

Job Responsibilities

Key
Metric

Develop, implement, and monitor project-specific commercial and contract strategies aligned with company objectives.
Commercial and contractual frameworks established and implemented on time.

Lead contract negotiations, variations, and claims to ensure favorable commercial outcomes.
Negotiations completed within timeline; variations and claims resolved effectively.

Monitor compliance to applicable codes, practices, QA/QC policies, performance standards and specifications.
The projects are all in compliance.

Identify and mitigate commercial and contractual risks through proactive analysis and recommendations.
Risk register maintained and mitigation actions tracked.

Maintain and actively implement SHE programs and responsibility (involve identify, mitigate and monitor SHE risk), including SHE Management System to ensure the effectiveness of the programs conform to official standard, requirements and procedure applied and to confirm the execution of the SHE Responsibility meet the intended outcome
- SHE risk well maintained

- Target Zero LTI

- SHE Management System meets the current ISO 14001, ISO 45001, SMK3 & SMKP standards and requirements

Education

Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Business Administration, or Law.

Skill, Knowledge, and Experience

• Minimum of 7 years of experience in commercial and contract management
• Proven expertise in contract negotiation, tender management, and project cost control.
• Strong understanding of commercial risk, cost analysis, and business profitability.
• Demonstrated ability to prepare and manage claims, variations, and contractual correspondence.
• Excellent analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
• Proficiency in English (spoken and written).
• Willing to travel to project sites as required

Certification

Other Requirements

Carry out daily Parent Stock farm activities according to work instructions and SOPs.
Perform routine tasks such as feeding, egg collection, cleaning, and flock care.
Observe and report flock conditions, mortality, and operational abnormalities to the supervisor.
Follow biosecurity, animal welfare, safety, and hygiene requirements at all times.
Maintain cleanliness of facilities, equipment, and work areas.
Record daily operational data accurately as instructed.
Support team activities to ensure smooth and efficient farm operations.




JAPFA is an agribusiness company that engages mainly in the production of animal feed, poultry breeding, commercial farm, consumer products, aquaculture, and beef cattle farming. Founded in Indonesia and now headquartered in Singapore, we employ over 37,000 people across an integrated network of modern farming, processing and distribution facilities in Indonesia, Vietnam, India, Myanmar, and Bangladesh. We believe our people are the key to staying ahead, and we continuously seek talented individuals to grow with us and contribute to our mission.
